[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested the name "Chronicles of Everia."  
[USER] User requested basic rules for "Chronicles of Everia" that uses 10-sided dice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided basic rules for "Chronicles of Everia" including:  
- Character Creation: Roll 3d10 six times for attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma).  
- Combat: Determine initiative by rolling a d10 and adding Dexterity modifier; attack by rolling a d10 and adding Attack bonus.  
- Skill Checks: Roll a d10 and add relevant attribute modifier to meet difficulty class.  
- Magic: Roll a d10 and add Spellcasting bonus to cast spells.  
- Experience and Leveling Up: Experience awarded for defeating enemies and completing quests.
